verdict.rationale: Pylon is an AI-heavy SaaS platform, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no such opt-out, control, or policy. The 'training data' docs describe customers connecting their own knowledge sources for Pylon's AI to consume, not excluding their data from model training. The SOC 2 / ISO 27001 certifications are adjacent security posture and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
